from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyCompletion(BaseModel):
    """A single month's housing completion data extracted from a document."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data refers to, formatted as YYYY-MM")
    south_completions: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate for South completions in thousands")
    northeast_completions: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate for Northeast completions in thousands")
    midwest_completions: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate for Midwest completions in thousands")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the press release/document was issued, used to resolve data conflicts")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    monthly_completions: list[MonthlyCompletion]
